the fetal kidney in culture is a very useful model to study the influence of various hormones on the growth, maturation and function of this organ.
fetal organs in culture can be stimulated by a combination of growth factors, but the effectiveness of this combination depends on age and the stage of differentiation of the tissue.
fetal tissues are not only responsive to a single growth factor but are able to respond to a complex combination of growth and differentiation factors.
